title: [Phase 403] Global Semiconductor Manufacturing Intelligence Platform
summary:
## Overview

Phase 403: Global Semiconductor Manufacturing Intelligence Platform - Cleanroom manufacturing intelligence platform monitoring fabrication lines, yields, and production quality for semiconductor facilities.

## What We Are Building

A comprehensive platform providing real-time monitoring of semiconductor fabrication operations including wafer yield tracking, equipment health monitoring, defect detection, and production scheduling.

## Dashboard Sections

### Hero Section
- Fab Yield percentage display
- Running Production Lines counter
- Wafer Output tracker
- Equipment Health indicator

### Main Dashboard Sections
1. Fabrication Overview with yield tracking
2. Wafer Production with lot tracking
3. Cleanroom Monitoring with environmental controls
4. Equipment Health with predi

title: [Phase 421] Global Semiconductor Supply Chain Intelligence Platform
summary:
## Overview
Phase 421: Global Semiconductor Supply Chain Intelligence Platform - Mission-critical semiconductor supply chain dashboard for monitoring chip fabrication, supplier ecosystems, logistics, production capacity, inventory, and geopolitical manufacturing risks.
## What We Build
Develop a comprehensive semiconductor supply chain platform that provides real-time visibility into wafer production, fab utilization, supplier dependencies, and logistics intelligence.
## Dashboard Sections
### Hero Section
- Global Fab Capacity percentage
- Wafer Production volume tracking
- Supplier Health index rating
- Supply Chain Risk level
### Main Dashboard (16 sections)
1. Global Fab Network monitoring
2. Supplier Intelligence tracking
3. Wafer Production metrics
4. Equipment Availability status
